answers.reason: The senate decides university-wide strategy, which is not the single place where a junior professor's matters are decided.
Budget planning is the domain of the central administration and chancellor, not the junior professor.
As a professor in the faculty, the junior professor takes part in the committee or round matching their core academic role, though appointment committees or research funding are specific.
The faculty council is chaired by the dean and handles general faculty affairs rather than the specific matter of the junior professor.
The study commission deals with degree programmes, which is not the primary area of a junior professor building a research group.
Examination matters are handled by those responsible for examinations, not the junior professor.
The junior professor builds up a research group, making the internal research funding round the one place where their specific matters are decided.
Every member only takes part in one body, and the junior professor's focus is building a research group rather than module descriptions.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a separate matter from the junior professor's primary focus.
Orientation week planning is for new students and not the area of the junior professor.
